title: Solid State
description: config.ini [Solid State] section (SolidStateConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

enabled.description: Relax the cell with the atoms in minimization and in min-mode saddle search. False keeps the cell frozen.

weight.description: Multiplier on the Jacobian J = V^(1/3) N^(1/6). 1 weights a cell strain like an atomic displacement.

pressure.description: Hydrostatic pressure in eV/Angstrom^3 added to the external stress. Positive pressure favors a smaller cell.

stress.description: External Cauchy stress in eV/Angstrom^3, nine row-major numbers. Added to pressure on the diagonal.

mask.description: Six flags for the lower-triangular strain, xx yx yy zx zy zz. 0 freezes that component. All zeros keeps the cell frozen.
